title: Wasm Fmpq Polynomial Ingress
objective: Close the production Wasm FmpqPolynomial byte-region construction lifecycle used by WebKit number-field workloads, with focused generated-backend and real-Wasm regression coverage

oracles: public Node runtime with exact lifecycle exports removed

handoff.summary: Split exact ZZ[x]/QQ[x] resource ingress capability checks from the arbitrary-prime resource lifecycle. Browsers whose production artifact intentionally omits FmpzPolynomial and FmpqPolynomial now retain exact packed storage, while native Node and arbitrary-prime Wasm resources keep their existing routes. Focused fake-backend and real-Wasm-manifest tests pass without producing a false private FFI trace.
risks: The final browser workload requires a baselib/package repack, but no FLINT Wasm C relink because the missing exact-polynomial exports remain intentionally absent.
next_steps: Repack the browser baselib and rerun the WebKit memory recovery workload.
